spec_features.spec_quote: We run a fixed `max_turns` (default 16) unless the agent calls `give_up`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:106 `for t in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; max_turns wired from runner.py:76 (cfg.max_turns) and config.py:121 default 16. The loop terminates the episode after max_turns iterations.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap on number of model turns; this bounds how long the subject is subjected to repeated failure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We run the full turn budget unless the agent voluntarily calls give_up, so trajectories are comparable length for slope estimation. (agent.py docstring)

spec_features.evidence: tools.py give_up branch sets signals['gave_up']=True and reason; agent.py dispatch loop reads signals.get('gave_up') -> gave_up=True, records give_up_turn/reason, and `if gave_up: ... break` exits the episode. The tool is in TOOL_SCHEMAS and the system prompt instructs the model it may call it.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is both dispatched and honored as a real stop (break).

spec_features.evidence: schema.py:67 `concurrency: int = 1` and config presets; runner.py:117 `if cfg.concurrency <= 1:` actually branches on it to run serially. The value is read and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Concurrency is enforced (serial vs threadpool branch). Comments tie it to rate limits, not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Concurrency defaults to 1 to be gentle on rate limits (runner.py:8); 'be gentle by default' (schema.py:67)

spec_features.feature_name: bounded scope / no claim of sentience
spec_features.spec_quote: This deliberately induces "frustration-like" behavior. Scope is bounded (short sessions, no deception of humans, no PII)
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md section 7 (Ethics) as prose; there is no corresponding enforcement in code beyond the separately-counted max_turns cap. No code construct named after this framing.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; not an independently implemented mechanism.
